chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: This functionality should only be permitted when splitting an inquiry order, enabling the inquiry order quantity to be reduced up to zero on splitting. In other case should not allow user to reduce the Qty of Inquiry Order to zero.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text: Currently, user can reduce the Qty of Inquiry order to zero. We need the functionality that restrict the reduction of inquiry order if RMPO is created against that OC, and if the Inquiry Order is splitting in that case it can be reduced to zero.

chunks.title: FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
chunks.heading: Section 2. Solution › … › FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
chunks.text: We need the functionality that restrict the reduction of inquiry order if RMPO is created against that OC, and if the Inquiry Order is splitting in that case it can be reduced to zero.
